caseNameFull: EDWARDS, GOVERNOR OF LOUISIANA, Et Al. v. HEALY Et Al.
attorneys: Kendall L. Vick, Assistant Attorney General of Louisiana, argued the cause for appellants. On the. brief were William J. Guste, Jr., Attorney General, and Warren E. Mouledoux, First Assistant Attorney General., Ruth Bader Ginsburg argued the cause for appellees. With her on the brief was Melvin L. Wulf*

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The judgment of the District Court for the Eastern District of Louisiana is vacated and the case is remanded to that court to consider whether in the light of recent changes in the state constitutional, statutory, and other rules applicable to this case the cause has become moot.

Mr. Justice Douglas took no part in the decision of this case.
